mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 5.0% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, thereby increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending power and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) declines more than 0.5% month-over-month and the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a dual contraction in demand and monetary policy, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS (mo/mo) decline > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market contraction (HOUST < 1300 thousand units), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and financial sector stress.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A nonfarm payrolls level below 160,000 thousand persons indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 160,000.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 102.0 indicates a contraction in the industrial sector, reducing corporate earnings and investor confidence, thereby producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 102.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline more than 1.0% month-over-month and industrial production (INDPRO) falls more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST (mo/mo) decline > 1.0% and INDPRO (mo/mo) decline > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level above 700,000 million dollars indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, thereby producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 700,000.
